## Installation

### PyPI Package
```bash
pip install --upgrade llm-governance-toolkit
```

### From Source
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Gergo89/llm-governance-toolkit.git
cd llm-governance-toolkit
git checkout v${version}
pip install -e .
```
